kv2.10:1.3: Lokuttare sote paṭihaññati no lokiye, lokuttarena viññāṇena paṭivijānanti no lokiyena, sāvakā paṭivijānanti no puthujjanā ti?
kv2.10:2.1: Nanu Buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiye sote paṭihaññatīti?
kv2.10:2.3: Hañci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiye sote paṭihaññati, no vata re vattabbe
kv2.10:3.1: Nanu Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ lokiyena viññāṇena paṭivijānantīti?
kv2.10:3.3: Hañci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ lokiyena viññāṇena paṭivijānanti, no vata re vattabbe
kv2.10:4.1: Nanu Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ puthujjanā paṭivijānantīti?
kv2.10:4.3: Hañci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ puthujjanā paṭivijānanti, no vata re vattabbe
kv2.10:5.3: Maggo, phalaṃ, nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo, sotāpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmimaggo, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmimaggo, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattamaggo, arahattaphalaṃ, satipaṭṭhānaṃ, sammappadhānaṃ, iddhipādā, indriyaṃ, balaṃ, bojjhaṅgo ti?
kv2.10:6.3: Atthi keci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇantīti?
kv2.10:6.5: Lokuttaro dhammo sotaviññeyyo, sotasmiṃ paṭihaññati, sotassa āpāthaṃ āgacchatīti?
kv2.10:7.1: Nanu lokuttaro dhammo na sotaviññeyyo, na sotasmiṃ paṭihaññati, na sotassa āpāthaṃ āgacchatīti?
kv2.10:7.3: Hañci lokuttaro dhammo na sotaviññeyyo, na sotasmiṃ paṭihaññati, na sotassa āpāthaṃ āgacchati, no vata re vattabbe
kv2.10:8.3: Atthi keci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāre rajjeyyun ti?
kv2.10:8.5: Lokuttaro dhammo rāgaṭṭhānīyo, rajanīyo, kamanīyo, madanīyo, bandhanīyo, mucchanīyo ti?
kv2.10:9.1: Nanu lokuttaro dhammo na rāgaṭṭhānīyo, na rajanīyo, na kamanīyo, na madanīyo, na bandhanīyo, na mucchanīyo ti?
kv2.10:9.3: Hañci lokuttaro dhammo na rāgaṭṭhānīyo, na rajanīyo, na kamanīyo, na madanīyo, na bandhanīyo, na mucchanīyo, no vata re vattabbe
kv2.10:10.3: Atthi keci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ dusseyyun ti?
kv2.10:10.5: Lokuttaro dhammo dosaṭṭhānīyo, kopaṭṭhānīyo, paṭighaṭṭhānīyo ti?
kv2.10:11.1: Nanu lokuttaro dhammo na dosaṭṭhānīyo, na kopaṭṭhānīyo, na paṭighaṭṭhānīyo ti?
kv2.10:11.3: Hañci lokuttaro dhammo na dosaṭṭhānīyo, na kopaṭṭhānīyo, na paṭighaṭṭhānīyo, no vata re vattabbe
kv2.10:12.3: Atthi keci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāre muyheyyun ti?
kv2.10:12.5: Lokuttaro dhammo mohaṭṭhānīyo, aññāṇakaraṇo, acakkhukaraṇo, paññānirodhiko, vighātapakkhiko, anibbānasaṃvattaniko ti?
kv2.10:13.1: Nanu lokuttaro dhammo na mohaṭṭhānīyo, na aññāṇakaraṇo, na acakkhukaraṇo, paññāvuddhiko, avighātapakkhiko, nibbānasaṃvattaniko ti?
kv2.10:13.3: Hañci lokuttaro dhammo na mohaṭṭhānīyo, na aññāṇakaraṇo, na acakkhukaraṇo, paññāvuddhiko, avighātapakkhiko, nibbānasaṃvattaniko, no vata re vattabbe
kv2.10:14.3: Ye keci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇanti, sabbe te maggaṃ bhāventīti?
kv2.10:15.1: Ye keci Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇanti, sabbe te maggaṃ bhāventīti?
kv2.10:15.3: Bālaputhujjanā Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇanti, bālaputhujjanā maggaṃ bhāventīti?
kv2.10:15.9: saṃghabhedakā Buddhassa bhagavato vohāraṃ suṇanti, saṃghabhedakā maggaṃ bhāventīti?
kv2.10:16.1: Labbhā sovaṇṇayāya laṭṭhiyā dhaññapuñjo pi suvaṇṇapuñjo pi ācikkhitun ti?

kv2.10:17.1: Labbhā elaṇḍiyāya laṭṭhiyā dhaññapuñjo pi suvaṇṇapuñjo pi ācikkhitun ti?
kv2.10:17.3: Evameva Bhagavā lokiyena vohārena lokiyaṃ pi lokuttaraṃ pi dhammaṃ voharatīti. 9.
kv2.10:18.1: Buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyo hoti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttaro hotīti?
kv2.10:18.3: Lokiyaṃ voharantassa so lokiye sote paṭihaññati, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttare sote paṭihaññati;
kv2.10:18.4: lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyena viññāṇena paṭivijānanti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttarena viññāṇena paṭivijānanti;
kv2.10:18.5: lokiyaṃ voharantassa puthujjanā paṭivijānanti lokuttaraṃ voharantassa sāvakā paṭivijānantīti?
kv2.10:19.2: "Buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyo hoti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttaro hotīti"?
kv2.10:19.4: Nanu Bhagavā lokiyaṃ pi lokuttaraṃ pi dhammaṃ voharatīti?
kv2.10:19.6: Hañci Bhagavā lokiyaṃ pi lokuttaraṃ pi dhammaṃ voharati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv2.10:19.7: Buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyo hoti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttaro hotīti." 11.
kv2.10:20.1: Buddhassa bhagavato vohāro lokiyaṃ voharantassa lokiyo hoti, lokuttaraṃ voharantassa lokuttaro hotīti?
kv2.10:20.3: Maggaṃ voharantassa maggo hoti, amaggaṃ voharantassa amaggo hoti; phalaṃ voharantassa phalaṃ hoti, aphalaṃ voharantassa aphalaṃ hoti; nibbānaṃ voharantassa nibbānaṃ hoti, anibbānaṃ voharantassa anibbānaṃ hoti; saṃkhataṃ voharantassa saṃkhataṃ hoti, asaṃkhataṃ voharantassa asaṃkhataṃ hoti; rūpaṃ voharantassa rūpaṃ hoti, arūpaṃ voharantassa arūpaṃ hoti; vedanaṃ voharantassa vedanā hoti, avedanaṃ voharantassa avedanā hoti; saññaṃ voharantassa saññā hoti, asaññaṃ voharantassa asaññā hoti; saṃkhāre voharantassa saṃkhārā honti, asaṃkhāre voharantassa asaṃkhārā honti; viññāṇaṃ voharantassa viññāṇaṃ hoti, aviññāṇaṃ voharantassa aviññāṇaṃ hotīti?
